set.body:
Journey 2 of docs/plan.md.

Done when
A permitted researcher finds the study by its description and opens one page that shows who holds it, what it contains by participant and data type, and what needs attention, in plain language. SEE8 is the acceptance rehearsal.

Why this journey carries the interface work
The console has a coherent visual language and a strong file inspector. What a principal investigator or the Vice-President, Research sees first is missing or reads like an operator form: there is no study page, screens lead with digests and rule names, and data types beyond MRI are visible only as file-tree folders. SEE1 settles the design of the front of house before SEE4, SHARE1 and OPEN1 build it.

Data types
MRI, behaviour and questionnaire tables are checked in depth (assessed). EEG, iEEG, MEG, NIRS, PET, motion and eye-tracking recorded as BIDS physio are checked by name and metadata (described). Anything else is stored and labelled (preserved). Signal-level readers for EEG, MEG and eye-tracking are parked under the multimodal plan until a real study needs them.

Order
SEE1 and SEE2 start now. SEE3 follows SEE2. SEE4 follows SEE1. SEE5 is independent engine work. SEE6 and SEE7 improve the journey. SEE8 closes it.
set.title: SEE: Find a study and understand it on one page
